AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
April 12, 2023
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

110 N. Aspan Ave - Use Permit (UP-2022-06) ? The Planning Commission will consider a request for a Use Permit to allow for the collocation of a new wireless carrier on an existing cell tower located within the West End Light Industrial District (DWL). The proposal calls for the installation of (3) new antennas, (1) Dish hybrid cable, (1) ice bridge, (1) GPS unit, and a new concrete pad to accommodate new ground equipment.
Item F1 - 110 N. Aspan Ave
2.
Lot Line Adjustment (LLA-2022-01) ? The Planning Commission will consider a request to adjust the eastern lot line of 1728 Ranch Road, Parcel A (APN 8684-023-014), to be moved further east onto 1720 Ranch Road Parcel B (APN 8684-023-016), for purposes of accommodating a proposed accessory dwelling unit on Parcel A. Both properties are located within the NG3 ? Low density residential zone designation.
Item F-2 - 1720 1728 Ranch Road
3.
1034 N. Enid Street (DR- 2022-03 and ADU 2022-08) - The Planning Commission will consider a request for a Design Review for construction of a new two-story 6,255 square foot single family residence with an attached three-car garage at the rear of the property, and a Discretionary Review for an attached second floor 1,142 square foot attached Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) on a 9,817 square foot lot. The property is located in the NG1 ? Low density zone. Proposed exterior materials for the house include smooth stucco, vinyl siding, and stacked stone.
Item F-3 - 1034 N. Enid
4.
Development Code Amendment 252 ? Housing Element Program Implementations The Planning Commission will consider making a recommendation to the City Council regarding proposed Amendments to Sections 88.42.200 (Senior Citizen Apartments), 88.26.005 (Allowable Uses in Corridors), 88.26.005 (Allowable Uses in Districts), 88.22.065 (Allowable Uses in Neighborhoods), and Chapter 88.32 Affordable Housing Incentives of the Azusa Municipal Code to: allow stacked flats as a type of housing in any zone or district where townhomes are permitted, add senior apartments as a permitted use in the NG3- Medium Density zoning district, remove Minor Use Permit (MUP) requirement for triplexes and fourplexes, and townhouses and rowhouses in higher density Neighborhood Districts, remove MUP requirement for senior citizen apartments in all zones where it is currently permitted with a MUP, and allow as a permitted use, update the Density Bonus sections to by consistent with state law. The proposed amendments would implement programs included in the City?s adopted Housing Element.
